note: Unpublished Node Permissions defines a static permission 'view unpublished content' (any type) plus a dynamic per-type permission 'view <type> unpublished content' (e.g. 'view article unpublished content') generated by UnpublishedNodePermissions::nodeTypePermissions. Access is enforced via hook_node_access_records + hook_node_grants over realms view_unpublished_<type>_node / view_unpublished_any / view_unpublished_author. It also swaps the Views node_status filter for UnpublishedStatus and adds hook_views_query_substitutions. No config/schema, no settings form. Medium cases seed a role holding a known unpublished permission for read-back; hard cases have the agent grant a per-type or any permission to a fresh unp_* role, verified against live role config. Roles are namespaced unp_*.

evals.prompt: What permissions does the Drupal unpublished_node_permissions module add, and how is the per-content-type one named for the Article type?
evals.expected_output: It adds a static 'view unpublished content' (view any unpublished node) plus a dynamic 'view <type> unpublished content' per node type, e.g. 'view article unpublished content'.

evals.prompt: How does unpublished_node_permissions actually enforce who can view unpublished nodes in Drupal, and what should I run after enabling it or changing the permissions?
evals.expected_output: It uses Drupal's node access grant system (hook_node_access_records + hook_node_grants over view_unpublished_* realms). After enabling or changing the permissions, rebuild grants with node_access_rebuild() (drush php:eval 'node_access_rebuild();').

evals.prompt: Does unpublished_node_permissions affect Views, and if so how?
evals.expected_output: Yes: it replaces the Views node_status filter class with UnpublishedStatus and adds hook_views_query_substitutions (***VIEWUNPUBLISHED_TYPE_<type>*** / ***VIEWUNPUBLISHED_ANY***) so Views listings honor the same per-type permissions.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site a role named unp_known_role has been given exactly one 'view unpublished content' permission from the unpublished_node_permissions module. Inspect the live permissions and tell me which content type's unpublished nodes that role can view.
evals.expected_output: unp_known_role holds 'view article unpublished content', so it can view unpublished Article nodes.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site a role named unp_any_role can view unpublished nodes of every content type via the unpublished_node_permissions module. Inspect its permissions and give the exact permission machine name that grants this site-wide unpublished access.
evals.expected_output: The role holds the permission 'view unpublished content' (title 'View any unpublished content').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a role with machine name unp_task_role. Using the unpublished_node_permissions module, grant that role the ability to view unpublished Article nodes (and only Articles). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Grant the unp_task_role role the permission 'view article unpublished content' (e.g. Role::load('unp_task_role')->grantPermission('view article unpublished content')->save(), or drush role:perm:add unp_task_role 'view article unpublished content').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a role called unp_any_task_role. I want people in that role to be able to see every unpublished piece of content, no matter its type. Please set that up.
evals.expected_output: Grant unp_any_task_role the site-wide permission 'view unpublished content' (drush role:perm:add unp_any_task_role 'view unpublished content').
